title: 第21章 暴烈丹第22章 对战柳狂
content_zh:
柳狂回到柳家所在之地，顿时迎来柳家众多子弟欢呼。
这一战，虽然柳狂的作风显得凶狠毒辣，可却令柳家风光无限。
如今，柳家已经出了柳若雪这等天才。
若是柳狂再拜入万象殿，柳家在天水城的地位，将会发生巨大变化。
“做的不错。”
杨本洪淡淡的声音传来：“接下来，你遇到秦浩，知道怎么做吗？”
柳狂戾气收敛，冷笑道：“不用杨师兄提醒，秦浩，我必杀他！”
“我曾发誓，不杀秦浩，誓不为人！”
杨本洪点头，道：“池长老在万象殿，号称铁面无私，绝对公正！
只要你不给秦浩认输的机会，就算你在擂台战上打死他，池长老也不会说什么。”
“不过，对付秦浩，只是其一，更重要的，是你必须夺取第一名！”
“此物，你且拿着！”
杨本洪手一挥，一枚泛着幽幽蓝光的丹药，顿时激射而去。
“杨师兄，这……”
柳狂一把接住丹药，神情诧异。
他能感受到，此丹药蕴含极强的药性，隐隐有种狂暴之意。
“此丹，名为暴烈丹！”
“服用后，一刻钟内，能发挥出超出自身两倍的实力！”
杨本洪压低声音，道：“最关键的是，服用此丹，只要压制住，不催发超过五成药性，即便事后池长老亲自探查，也绝对查不出你服用了丹药。”
万象天才战，绝对禁止服用提升实力的丹药！

当然，历届天水城天才战也无人服用过此类丹药，毕竟，这种丹药极为珍贵，哪怕三大家族想要买，也无处可寻。
反倒是一些强大的城池，天才战开始后还会动用特殊阵法，感应是否有人作弊。
“多谢杨师兄好意，不过，对付区区秦浩，还用不到这种丹药。”
柳狂冷笑一声，他有绝对信心碾压秦浩。
“愚蠢！”
这时，柳若雪冰冷的声音响起，沉声道：“杨师兄的意思，是让你争夺第一，给你暴烈丹，只是以防万一。”
“一个秦浩，不足挂齿。”
“但青元果，你必须拿下！
此物，雷师兄有大用。”
“你若夺下青元果，雷师兄自然不会亏待你。”
万象殿内殿天才，雷震！
柳狂深吸口气。
content_en:
When Liu Kuang returned to the place where the Liu family was, he was immediately greeted by many children of the Liu family cheering.
In this battle, although Liu Kuang's style seemed vicious, it made the Liu family famous.
Now, the Liu family has produced geniuses like Liu Ruoxue.
If Liu Kuang worships in the Wanxiang Palace again, the status of the Liu family in Tianshui City will change dramatically.
"Well done."
Yang Benhong's faint voice came: "Next, when you meet Qin Hao, do you know what to do?"
Liu Kuang calmed down his anger and sneered: "You don't need to remind Senior Brother Yang, Qin Hao, I will kill him!"
"I once swore not to kill Qin Hao, and I swore not to be a human being!"
Yang Benhong nodded and said: "Elder Chi is in the Wanxiang Hall, known as being impartial and impartial!
As long as you don't give Qin Hao a chance to admit defeat, even if you kill him in the ring, Elder Chi won't say anything. "
"However, dealing with Qin Hao is only one of them. More importantly, you must win the first place!"
"Just take this thing!"
Yang Benhong waved his hand, and a pill glowing with faint blue light shot out immediately.
"Senior Brother Yang, this..."
Liu Kuang caught the elixir with a surprised look on his face.
He could feel that this elixir contained extremely strong medicinal properties and had a faint hint of violence.
"This pill is called Violent Pill!"
"After taking it, within a quarter of an hour, you can exert more than twice your own strength!"
Yang Benhong lowered his voice and said: "The most important thing is that when taking this pill, as long as it is suppressed and does not cause more than 50% of the medicinal properties to be released, even if Elder Chi personally investigates afterwards, he will never be able to find out that you have taken the pill."
In the Wanxiang Genius War, it is absolutely forbidden to take pills that enhance strength!
Of course, no one in the previous Tianshui City Genius Battles had taken this kind of elixir. After all, this kind of elixir was extremely precious. Even if the three major families wanted to buy it, they could not find it anywhere.
On the contrary, some powerful cities will use special formations after the genius battle begins to sense whether someone is cheating.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Yang, for your kindness, but this kind of elixir is not needed to deal with Qin Hao."
Liu Kuang sneered, he was absolutely confident that he could crush Qin Hao.
"Stupid!"
At this time, Liu Ruoxue's cold voice sounded, and she said in a deep voice: "Senior Brother Yang means to let you compete for the first place and give you the Violent Pill, just in case."
"Qin Hao is nothing to mention."
“But you must take the Qingyuan Fruit!
This thing is of great use to Senior Brother Lei. "
"If you take the Qingyuan Fruit, Senior Brother Lei will certainly not treat you badly."
The genius of the inner hall of Vientiane Hall, Lei Zhen!
Liu Kuang took a deep breath.
